case_name: Smt. Priyanka Devi vs Vijay Singh
facts_of_case: The wife filed an appeal challenging the decree of divorce and sought to restrain the husband from remarrying.

legal_principles.principle: An appeal shall stand dismissed without further reference to the Court if notice is not paid within seven working days.
legal_principles.held: sue notice to the respondent on payment of process fee within next seven working days, failing which present appeal shall stand dismissed without further reference to the Court.

legal_principles.principle: A spouse cannot remarry if an appeal challenging a decree of divorce has been filed within the prescribed period of limitation.
legal_principles.held: Section 15 Hindu Marriage Act which debars remarriage by the opposite party, if the appeal has been filed by the spouse of the opposite party challenging the decree of divorce within the prescribed period of limitation.

outcome.final_order: The respondent is restrained from remarrying, as per Section 15 Hindu Marriage Act.

use_for_drafting: seeking restraining order in family court
understanding Section 15 of Hindu Marriage Act
